method: Real field-recorded storm passages retain native thunder cadence and complete rolling tails. Passages play sequentially, with quiet edge fades and a genuinely recorded rain floor; no generated cracks, triggered strikes, pitch shifts or overlapping storm scenes. Licensed source bank: assets/recordings/sources.json.
provenance: Licensed real-weather recordings, sequenced at native speed and cadence. Finite passages are reused; no generated thunder impulses or synthetic glass taps.
license_notes: Source declarations and credits are in assets/recordings/sources.json and embedded in MP4 metadata. See site/recording-credits.txt for publication credit text.

master_loudness.analyzer: FFmpeg ebur128 with true-peak analysis; summary precision 0.1 dB. No normalization applied.

audio_qc.limitations: Numerical screening cannot establish absence of audible clicks, repetition, or unnatural texture.

listening_review: Owner approved the 59-second real-thunder audition on 2026-11-02 and requested realistic native weather cadence with no artificial thunder overlap. Final long-mix and window-rain listening remain pending.
reference_comparison: Not performed; usable reference audio unavailable in the browsing tool.
status: Recorded-weather revision; complete numerical verification passed. Full-mix listening remains pending.
video_encoding: Re-encoded from the FLAC master by scripts/compress_videos.py: H264 picture segments copied; continuous AudioToolbox AAC at requested 160k.

video_qc.pixel_verification: Every decoded RGB byte compared directly against zero using verify_black_frames.c.

aac_loudness.analyzer: FFmpeg ebur128 with true-peak analysis; summary precision 0.1 dB. No normalization applied.

decoded_aac_qc.limitations: Numerical screening cannot establish absence of audible clicks, repetition, or unnatural texture.

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10
